hinge.title: Find a shortest path on the surface of a cuboid by unfolding to nets and comparing straight-line distances.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Surface path is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Find a shortest path on the surface of a cuboid by unfolding to nets' is answered as surface path rather than cuboid.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Straight-line distance comparison across unfoldings is what produces surface path, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Find a shortest path on the surface of a cuboid by.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: cuboid is settled by running 'Predict the next Koch Snowflake step by replacing every current side': The Koch Snowflake starts with an equilateral triangle; each side is divided into 3 equal — on the item about Find a shortest path on the surface of a cuboid by.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Cuboid is computed by squaring surface path and leaving cuboid linear, so the written value is 17 — on the item about Find a shortest path on the surface of a cuboid by.

intelligence.enrichment: A surface path on a cuboid can be transformed to a path of the same length on a net, and every path on a net transforms back to a surface path of the same length; a straight line on a chosen net is shortest for that unfolding, but different unfoldings can give different distances.
